title: Integrative Analysis of Mitochondrial-Related Genes Reveals Diagnostic Biomarkers and Therapeutic Targets in Acute Pancreatitis.
authors: Lin, Yun; Wan, Xing; Zhang, Xuetao; Liu, Jifeng; Lu, Xinyu; Wen, Qingping
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合转录组与MitoCarta基因筛选急性胰腺炎诊断标志物，虽含转录因子预测和分子动力学模拟，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且TF-DNA仅作辅助注释，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Mitochondrial dysfunction is increasingly recognised as a critical contributor to acinar cell injury and systemic inflammation in acute pancreatitis (AP). However, comprehensive screening of mitochondrial-related genes (MRGs) and their mechanistic roles in AP progression remains limited. We integrated transcriptomic data with MRGs from the MitoCarta database. A total of 34 differentially expressed MRGs were identified, enabling classification of AP samples into three molecular subtypes with distinct immune cell infiltration patterns and clinical severity. Three hub genes were consistently identified by three machine learning algorithms: LASSO, SVM-RFE, and RF. qRT-PCR validation in cellular models confirmed consistent expression trends. Multi-level functional annotation was conducted through GSVA, CIBERSORT, transcription factor prediction, subcellular localisation and single-cell analyses. Talniflumate and ABT-737 were predicted as potential therapeutic agents using the CMap and validated through molecular docking and 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations. This study establishes a mitochondria-related diagnostic model for AP and identifies candidate therapeutic agents, offering novel insights into the molecular pathogenesis and targeted intervention of AP.
abstract_zh: 线粒体功能障碍日益被认为是急性胰腺炎（AP）中腺泡细胞损伤和全身性炎症的关键因素。然而，对线粒体相关基因（MRGs）及其在AP进展中机制作用的全面筛选仍然有限。我们将转录组数据与来自MitoCarta数据库的MRGs进行整合。共鉴定出34个差异表达的MRGs，从而能够将AP样本分为三种具有不同免疫细胞浸润模式和临床严重程度的分子亚型。通过三种机器学习算法（LASSO、SVM-RFE和RF）一致识别出三个核心基因。在细胞模型中的qRT-PCR验证确认了表达趋势的一致性。通过GSVA、CIBERSORT、转录因子预测、亚细胞定位和单细胞分析进行了多层次功能注释。Talniflumate和ABT-737被预测为潜在治疗药物，使用CMap并通过分子对接和100纳秒分子动力学模拟进行验证。本研究建立了基于线粒体相关的AP诊断模型，并识别了候选治疗药物，为AP的分子发病机制和靶向干预提供了新见解。
